head: d3dc4c2c6
scope: Error feedback on print-receipt API failures
summary: Receipt modal has correct ARIA role/label, two-state print buttons with aria-busy, BYPASS marker with role=status + aria-live=polite, hidden v-print buttons correctly excluded from tab order (tabindex=-1 + aria-hidden). DuplicataMarker exposes role=status + aria-live=polite + visible 2px dashed red border with print-color-adjust:exact (legally required visibility on thermal printer). i18n keys label.duplicata / label.fiscal_ticket_no / label.legal_mentions / label.audit_fingerprint exist in fr.json and resolve via $t fallback. Three findings: (1) audit_emitted=false is silently ignored by the print client flow (operator never sees the SIEM-relevant warning); (2) re-print modal PosOrderReceiptComponent has NO duplicata marker (mirror of ARCH-PS4-002); (3) the BYPASS marker emoji prefix may produce odd VoiceOver output (minor).

findings.title: Receipt modal accessibility is well-formed
findings.evidence: L7: `role="document"` + `:aria-label="$t('a11y.receipt_preview')"` on the modal root. L19-23: close button uses aria-label=button.close. L25-44: print buttons use :aria-busy when isPrinting + disabled when isPrinting (prevents both keyboard and pointer re-entry). L46-60: hidden v-print buttons have tabindex=-1 + aria-hidden=true (correctly excluded from tab order). L9-17: BYPASS marker uses role=status + aria-live=polite + data-testid for E2E. Tax-lines table (L168-179) uses semantic <table><thead><tbody> with scope=col headers. The paper-print zone (#print-receipt-client / #print-receipt-kitchen) is rendered for both print AND DOM so screen readers can navigate it before triggering print.

findings.title: audit_emitted=false from print-receipt API is silently swallowed — operator never sees SIEM-relevant warning
findings.evidence: PosReceiptPrintController L77-104 returns `audit_emitted` in the JSON response. The backend doc-comment explicitly states (L21-28) that audit chain failure must be surfaced to the UI so the manager can be warned. ReceiptComponent.vue handlePrintClientClick (L490-531) reads ONLY `data?.receipt_print_count` and discards the rest of the payload. There is no alert/toast when audit_emitted=false. A chain-loss event (fiscal-relevant) would print successfully and never reach the operator's attention. The 5xx-style alertService.warning paths (L506-517) handle HTTP errors but not the audit_emitted=false in a 200 response.
findings.recommendation: P2 heal-allowed: after `this.localPrintCount = ...` line at L501-504, add `if (data?.audit_emitted === false) alertService.warning(this.$t('pos.receipt_audit_chain_warning'));`. Add the i18n key with safe fallback. NF525 ops impact: ensures the manager can flag to SIEM that a fiscal write failed. Frozen-zone impact: zero (ReceiptComponent is not in the frozen list). Safe to heal in this audit if time permits — see STATUS.md for decision.

findings.title: Re-print history modal (PosOrderReceiptComponent) lacks DUPLICATA visibility on the paper ticket
findings.evidence: This component does not import ReceiptDuplicataMarker (mirror finding of ARCH-PS4-002). A manager opening an old order from /admin/posOrders and clicking print will produce a paper ticket missing the legally-required DUPLICATA marker. Note: the user-facing day-to-day re-print path goes through PosOrdersTrackerComponent → ReceiptComponent which IS correct, so this is a latent surface, not the primary flow. NF525 risk: if a manager uses this admin surface for re-printing customer tickets, the paper will not carry the DUPLICATA mark.
findings.recommendation: P2 — V1.0.2 backlog. Either (a) consolidate the two receipt components, or (b) port the duplicata marker + NF525 footer block + POST print-receipt call to PosOrderReceiptComponent. Owner Aurore confirmation needed: which surface do managers actually use day-to-day?

findings.title: Kiosk receipt persistence — F5 recovery is correct and PII-safe
findings.evidence: Phase 9.1.12 helper has TTL (1h default, custom-respectful), version gating (refuses incompatible snapshots), corruption resilience (purges + null on broken JSON), no-localStorage no-op, anti-PII guard. The TTL ensures that a forgotten kiosk in idle state does not preserve order data for the next customer beyond a reasonable window.
findings.recommendation: Solid. Keep TTL at 1h — short enough to prevent customer-data carry-over, long enough to survive accidental F5.

findings.title: Duplicata marker visibility — print-color-adjust + 2px dashed red — legally compliant
findings.evidence: L44-57 .receipt-duplicata-marker has `border: 2px dashed #d92626`, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.05em, font-weight 700, AND -webkit-print-color-adjust:exact / color-adjust:exact / print-color-adjust:exact so the red border + color survive black-and-white thermal printer driver coercion. role=status + aria-live=polite for screen-reader announcement when the count flips. @media print { page-break-inside:avoid } so the marker does not split across two rolls. The fallback `DUPLICATA #N` is used if $t resolves to the key (key-not-found case) — ensures the legal text appears even with i18n missing keys.

findings.title: BYPASS marker emoji-first content may produce odd VoiceOver speech
findings.evidence: L17 renders `{{ bypassPrintingMarker }}` which defaults (L392) to `🔧 MODE TEST — IMPRESSION BYPASSÉE`. The emoji is not wrapped in aria-hidden=true, so VoiceOver will speak `wrench mode test impression bypassée`. Cosmetic, not blocking.
findings.recommendation: Low priority. Replace with `🔧 MODE TEST — IMPRESSION BYPASSÉE` or strip the emoji from the i18n string and add it via separate aria-hidden span. V1.0.2 polish.

findings.title: Print-button emoji not aria-hidden in ReceiptComponent toolbar
findings.evidence: L32 (kitchen 👨‍🍳), L42 (client 🧾): emoji rendered as text content. The button has an aria-busy + a sibling <span> with the i18n label, but the emoji is part of the accessible name. Result: VoiceOver speaks `man cook button print kitchen ticket`. Minor UX paper-cut.
findings.recommendation: Wrap emoji in aria-hidden="true" or use a CSS background-icon. V1.0.2 polish.

findings.title: Walk-in customer lookup endpoint returns a structured response — no UX issue
findings.evidence: Returns {status, data: {id, name, email}} — used by the cashier UI to pre-fill the customer block. No localisation needed (sentinel). 403 if missing perm — handled by the global axios error interceptor (assumed).
